children: Ithaca Energy has an expanding pipeline of development projects and capital-allocation flexibility, Barclays analyst Naisheng Cui writes. The company believes scale matters and could invest in U.K. North Sea projects or international expansion, the analyst writes after speaking to Chairman Yaniv Friedman at the Barclays CEO Energy-Power Conference. Ithaca has three developments that could reach a final investment decision, and over 200 million barrels of oil equivalent 2C resources under projects heading for potential FID in 2026 and 2027. 2C reserves are those that haven't yet met the threshold for commercial production. Shares closed Tuesday at 271.20 pence. (adam.whittaker@wsj.com)
